name: EDS TX road electronic
use_case: Road 1× or 2× electronic shifting with hydraulic or cable brakes
positioning: The broad-compatibility option: app-selectable cassette speed and a rim/cable-brake kit as well as hydraulic disc.
architecture: Fully wireless control with separate rechargeable batteries in the front and rear derailleurs; shifters use CR2032 cells.

weight.note: Hydraulic kit listings: 223 g per lever, 336 g rear derailleur, 191 g front derailleur and 163 g per caliper. Hoses, charging parts and small hardware are additional.

battery: Rear derailleur 800 mAh, front derailleur 500 mAh, claimed 20,000+ shifts and 800 charge cycles; shifters use CR2032. RD/FD are IP67 and shifters IP65.
controls_and_app: App sets cassette speed, button mapping, micro-adjustment, calibration, firmware and battery display; ANT+ integration is advertised.
package_summary: The official hydraulic kit includes two levers, front and rear derailleurs, two calipers and hoses, charging parts, instructions and spares. The observed Taobao options separate 1x/2x and alloy/carbon seller labels; crank, cassette, chain, rotors and bottom bracket were not visible as included. Cable kit omits calipers and hoses, and its lever internals are not interchangeable.

compatibility.freehub: Depends on the selected 3-14-speed cassette; verify cassette, chain and wheel together
compatibility.frame: No internal battery or electronic wire route; verify front-derailleur mount for 2x
compatibility.brake_fluid: Confirm the selected hydraulic revision; cable-brake kit has no hydraulic circuit

china_price_status: User-supplied Taobao screenshots show option-level hydraulic-kit prices from ¥2,369 for 1x alloy-labelled to ¥3,219 for 2x carbon-labelled. These are displayed options, not verified checkout totals; the unspecified ¥300 combination discount is excluded.

caveats: Keep the current 3-14-speed revision separate from older regional 7-13-speed TX records.

The 36T rear limit is narrower than many modern gravel 1× cassettes.
